alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:db6477fc-1.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. You’ll own the journey with customers from initial exploration to production deployment, translating ambiguous business goals into reliable, observable services with clear quality, latency, and cost outcomes. interplay-interplay:ashbyhq:88e52799-b2c.title: Head of Process Engineering, Vandrel
interplay-interplay:ashbyhq:88e52799-b2c.description: WHO ARE WE Vandrel is rebuilding America's high-performance magnet wire supply chain. We design and manufacture PEEK-insulated copper conductor in modular micro-factories, producing the wire that goes into the motors, transformers, and power systems that matter most: defense and aerospace platforms, EV traction, and grid and stationary storage. Today, insulated magnet wire is produced by a short list of European and Asian suppliers. That is a problem for every US program that needs higher voltage, higher temperature, or higher power density. Our team is small, senior, and hands-on, and we are closing that gap. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING - Design and Run the Process: Lead development and operation of Vandrel’s pilot extrusion line for PEEK-insulated copper magnet wire across target conductor gauges, from resin handling through finished, wound-ready wire. - Own the Copper-to-PEEK Interface: Drive surface preparation, oxidation control, adhesion strategy, and bond verification. A very short list of competitors has solved this. We intend to solve it better and patent the result. - Specify and Commission Equipment: Select, source, and bring up extruders, crossheads, dies, cooling, spooling, and inline metrology. Work directly with US, European, and Asian vendors to land equipment configured for PEEK processing. - Define the Quality Envelope: Set the standards for dielectric strength, pinhole rate, elongation, partial discharge behavior, thermal cycling, and fluid compatibility, and the metrology to prove them. - Drive Yield, Throughput, and IP: Take the process from pilot through first commercial runs. Build and document Vandrel’s process IP, trade secrets, and patentable methods. - Design for Replication: Translate line design into a modular, repeatable layout that supports Vandrel’s micro-factory deployment model. - Implement Manufacturing Intelligence: Integrate AI-driven computer vision and acoustic sensors to create a 'Digital Birth Certificate' for every spool, providing meter-by-meter traceability for defense and aerospace clients. - Build the Team: Hire and lead process engineers, technicians, and quality staR. Set a technical culture where senior people run the line alongside the operators. REQUIRED SKILLS - 10+ years in polymer extrusion, wire and cable manufacturing, or high-performance coatings, with at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role. - Hands-on experience with high-temperature thermoplastics; PEEK, PEKK, PAEK, or comparable semi-crystalline engineering polymers strongly preferred. - Demonstrated track record taking an extrusion or coating process from pilot into production, including yield, cost, and long-term reliability. - Real depth on the copper-to-polymer interface: surface prep, adhesion chemistry, thermal behavior, aging. - Ability to specify and qualify capital equipment from first principles, and to partner with vendors on PEEK-capable tooling. - Operator mindset: comfortable in PPE, at the crosshead, solving a defect at 2am if that is what the line needs. - Familiarity with IEC 60317 and NEMA MW 1000 magnet wire standards is a plus. COMPENSATION AND EQUITY Compensation is benchmarked to senior technical leadership at venture-backed hard tech companies. Base salary is competitive and equity is material; both scale with experience and scope of ownership. For candidates ready to anchor Vandrel’s technical side from day one, we are open to structuring this as a co-founder-level package: co-founder equity, commensurate title, and the authority that comes with it.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e910f3f9-49f7-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e910f3f9-49f7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Canada. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

sierrastudio-sierra-studio:ashbyhq:b4b28.title: Future Opportunities
sierrastudio-sierra-studio:ashbyhq:b4b28.description: FUTURE OPPORTUNITIES AT SIERRA STUDIO Are you a talented professional looking for exciting career opportunities in innovative companies? Sierra Studio is your gateway to a world of possibilities, both within our own dynamic team and across a curated network of growing startups in the United States. Whether you're passionate about product development, technology, marketing, finance, or any other field, we invite you to join our ecosystem of innovation and growth. ABOUT SIERRA STUDIO Sierra Studio operates on two synergistic fronts: 1. As an innovative product development firm, we empower founders and business leaders to create impactful, meaningful products and companies. Born from a Venture Studio in Los Angeles, we foster a culture of innovation and experimentation. 2. As a specialized staffing company, we connect talented Brazilian professionals with exciting career opportunities in a highly-vetted community of growing companies in the US. Our multifaceted approach encompasses: - Creating world-class user experiences - Developing sound technical foundations - Crafting effective marketing strategies - Implementing robust financial planning - Ideating and validating new business concepts - Launching and scaling innovative companies - Connecting top talent with cutting-edge startups At Sierra, we value diversity and care deeply about the people we work with, knowing that building high-trust relationships is the key to long-term success. THE SIERRA ECOSYSTEM When you apply to Sierra, you're not just applying for a single job – you're joining an ecosystem of opportunities. Here's what that means for you: - Automatic eligibility for all relevant opportunities within our network - Access to positions both within Sierra Studio and at our partner startups in the US - Exposure to a variety of innovative projects and companies - Opportunity to grow and evolve your career across different roles and industries WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR We seek talented individuals across various fields, including but not limited to: - Product Development - Software Engineering - UX/UI Design - Marketing and Brand Strategy - Finance and Business Operations - Project Management - Business Development - Data Analysis Regardless of your specific role or whether you work directly for Sierra or one of our partner companies, we value professionals who demonstrate: - A proactive attitude and growth mindset - Excellent communication skills - The ability to articulate complex concepts clearly - Drive to complete tasks with minimal supervision - Openness to learning and being challenged - A collaborative spirit and low ego - Adaptability to different work environments and cultures WHY JOIN THE SIERRA ECOSYSTEM? By applying to Sierra Studio, you open doors to numerous opportunities: - Access to roles in innovative startups and growing companies in the US - Be part of ideating, validating, and launching new companies - Work on diverse and challenging projects across various industries - Collaborate with talented, multidisciplinary teams in high-trust environments - Enjoy cultures that value inclusion and embrace differences - Benefit from our "growth mindset" approach, where we magnify strengths and learn from mistakes - Experience workplaces that don't try to fit you into a box, but value your unique skills and perspective We believe in nurturing talent and cultivating positive relationships. Our goal is to empower the world around us, and that starts by empowering you. When you join the Sierra ecosystem, we'll embrace who you are today and give you the space and tools to keep growing, regardless of your professional background. Learn more about us on our website (https://www.sierra.studio/) and see how you can be part of our mission to create impactful, meaningful products and businesses, either as part of our team or through our network of partner companies. Join us in shaping the future of innovation and entrepreneurship across borders!

turnriver-turn-river:ashbyhq:23f04521-5b.title: Investment Analyst (2027)
turnriver-turn-river:ashbyhq:23f04521-5b.description: ABOUT TURN/RIVER Turn/River Capital is a private equity firm that applies a proprietary growth engineering strategy to investing, partnering with software businesses to accelerate growth and build enduring value. The firm’s team of equal parts investors and operators provides hands-on operational support and the flexible capital to systematically scale marketing, sales and customer success at its portfolio companies. Founded in 2012 and based in San Francisco, Turn/River has $5.6bn in committed capital and invests globally with a focus on North America and Europe. About the Role This is a 2 year, entry-level Analyst program beginning August 2027 We’re looking for driven individuals with an interest in tech and finance to join Turn/River’s growing Investment & Sourcing Team. Turn/River partners with software companies by providing both capital and hands-on operational expertise, with a deep focus across marketing, sales, and customer operations. In this role, you’ll identify and evaluate B2B software businesses based on financial performance and operational improvement opportunities aligned with Turn/River’s proprietary go-to-market playbooks. You’ll speak directly with CEOs of software companies, learning how to grow software companies with modern strategies. Deal identification and sourcing is a critical function of our investment strategy, and exceptional performers will have the opportunity to grow into partner-track investing roles over time. Prior finance experience or coursework is a plus, but not required. We encourage applicants from varied backgrounds and undergraduate programs, including but not limited to marketing, communications, business, political science, and psychology. Ideal candidates will have high energy, provide thoughtful insights, excel in prioritization, and take creative approaches to identifying and getting in front of top prospects, all while working effectively within a team. Key Responsibilities - Identify and define market opportunities and verticals that are interesting to Turn/River - Engage with interesting companies and their CEOs that fit our target investment profile and get them excited about the Turn/River brand - Qualify companies through conversations and various operational and financial metrics, then present these findings to our broader investment team - Partner with investment professionals to deploy capital and execute transactions - Actively build and carry out sourcing processes, technologies, and positioning by A/B testing various marketing, sales, and growth best practices Qualifications - Undergraduate degree from a competitive program, with demonstrated strong academic performance - Strong communication and relationship-building skills - Avid self-learner - Ability to prioritize and perform multiple tasks simultaneously with extreme attention to detail - Strong project management and organizational skills - Passionate about investing, data, technology, and relationship development - Experience in B2B software, finance, and proficiency with sales tools a plus Location - San Francisco, CA (hybrid work model) Compensation - The annual base salary range for this role is $145,000-$155,000, taking into account numerous variable factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience, training, licensure, certifications, and organizational requirements.
